issue_request: FHIR-33057 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R5. R5 generated history contains the warning form, and later refactors removed XPath and normalized answerValueSet casing without reversing the warning.

The current source still has que-14 as a warning with expression answerConstraint.exists() implies answerOption.exists() or answerValueSet.exists(), and its human text says extensions may serve the same purpose. Confluence minutes corroborate the persuasive-with-modification disposition. Later Zulip/Jira background includes SDC-specific FHIR-41652 and separate core issue FHIR-40780, but neither changes the FHIR-core FHIR-33057 conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit.
